contents: # Also pulled in by requirements.txt for full-suite CI.
justification_global_pull: Full suite / CI installs requirements.txt only; include keeps CI green without editing every workflow job. Dedicated file documents predictive surface for operators.
lazy_imports: Partial — models/metrics still import numpy/sklearn at module load for train path; claims/weekly_section do not import sklearn
core_without_train: claims registry, honesty, weekly predictive_status do not require fitting models
attack_surface: numpy+scikit-learn present when requirements.txt installed (same as CI). Predictive timers not enabled on VPS.
